svg.title: Mission 02: didau
svg.desc: Mission 02: didau. A paper map on a sunlit table with four friends' pins, route strings meeting at one venue, and a printed screenshot of the Hangout Planner app. Hangout Planner. A shared room where the group suggests places, votes, and breaks ties in favour of whoever travels farthest. About 70,000 real venues across Ho Chi Minh City and Hanoi. No accounts.
